author: t. t. frank
title: Cassity Ann Vidrine arrested on narcotics and resisting charges in Evangeline Parish
text:
Cassity Ann Vidrine was arrested on April 1 on charges of possessing methamphetamine and resisting an officer by failing to identify, according to the Evangeline Parish Sheriff’s Office. Vidrine was also taken into custody for outstanding warrants from the Avoyelles Parish Sheriff’s Office, which had requested her apprehension.
The arrest involved one count of possession of Schedule II controlled dangerous substance (methamphetamine) under Louisiana Revised Statute 40:967 and one count of resisting an officer by failing to identify under Louisiana Revised Statute 14:108B1C. In addition to these charges, authorities said that John Foret, who was present during the incident, received a traffic citation for traffic-related offenses and was released at the scene.
Sheriff Charles R. Guillory urged community members with information about criminal activity to contact the Criminal Investigations Division at 337-363-2161 or submit tips through the agency’s website at www.evangelineparishsheriff.org. “Any person(s) reporting information will remain anonymous,” Guillory said.
The sheriff’s office emphasized that all suspects are presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.
This case highlights ongoing efforts by local law enforcement agencies to address drug-related offenses and ensure public safety through cooperation between parishes.
